text:
matt: Hey team — canary promotion for release v1.23.0 is paused by deploy-bot. Getting CI failures in the staging-e2e job, looks like an artifact/cache fetch stall. tagging @jess @sam

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for 1.23.0-canary (ID: promo-2026-03). Reason: staging-e2e failed. Logs: https://ci.redwood/dev/exec/7890 (public to org).

jess: On it. Which image/tag is being promoted? is this the new baseimage bump from last night?

sam: It's the build published at image:redwood/service:v1.23.0-20260320. I see S3 503s while pulling cache blobs; the job timed out waiting for artifact download.

ci-bot: Failed step snippet:
```
ERROR: failed to fetch layer sha256:8f3b... from s3://redwood-artifacts/cache/8f3b: 503 SlowDown
Caused by: MultipartUploadAbort: request aborted by upstream
Job: staging-e2e (attempt 1)
```

olivia: We have a 2-hour change window starting in ~90m. I'd prefer we don't do risky repeated deploys right before it. If we can pin to a known-good image and unblock, do that.

matt: My proposal: pin the canary to last-known-good image digest (sha256:abcd1234) and promote that instead of forcing a rebuild until the S3 issue is diagnosed. That unblocks downstream QA and the release branch cut. Thoughts? @sam can you confirm that digest corresponds to the last green run?

sam: Confirmed — sha256:abcd1234 was the image from the green pipeline yesterday at 03:12 UTC. We can promote that quickly. Rebuild with `--no-cache` is possible but if S3 is flaky the push may still fail. Reuploading blobs also risks hitting the same multipart failure. ETA to build/push no-cache ~18m if we want to go that route.

jess: Going to patch the release notes to mark a temporary pin and add a follow-up to revert once infra is stable. Suggested release note line:
```
- Temporary: pinned service image to sha256:abcd1234 for canary promotion due to artifact fetch incidents. Investigating cache reliability (INF-456).
```

matt: OK let's pin. @deploy-bot can you re-run promotion flow using image digest `sha256:abcd1234`? Mark the action as manual override in release metadata.

deploy-bot: Manual override received from matt. Resuming promotion for v1.23.0-canary using image sha256:abcd1234. Canary traffic set to 10%. Promotion ID promo-2026-03-OVR.

ci-bot: staging-e2e re-run (with pinned image) passed on attempt 2. Artifacts validated.

rachel: I'll create INF-456 to track root cause and owners (assigning to infra-team and sam). Also adding a postmortem label if we see recurrence.

matt: Thanks. @olivia please coordinate the change window notes: we'll still hold GA cut until we confirm no more cache regressions, but can proceed with canary validations.

olivia: Will update calendar and notify ops.

jess: I'll update release checklist: note pin, PR for unpin/rebuild when infra ticket closed.

sam: Follow-up next steps: collect S3 client logs, check multipart chunk size changes, and ask storage team about recent configuration changes. I'll post findings in INF-456.

matt: Nice work moving fast. everyone please :thumbsup: on the thread if you acknowledge the plan.

jess: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

olivia: :thumbsup:

rachel: :thumbsup:

// End of thread
